flagged.title: Human Fieldwork: Urban & Rural Settlements
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly defines stopping every fifth passer-by as random sampling rather than systematic sampling, which is a core fieldwork definition tested on GCSE exams.

mark_affecting.quote: First up, random sampling. In human fieldwork, this might mean stopping, say, every fifth passer-by... Second is systematic sampling. This means standing at fixed, regular sites.

flagged.title: UK Resources & Sustainability Challenge
flagged.reason: The video states that each extra person consumes 500 m³ of water annually (ten times too high), cites EV market share as over 30% rather than ~20% (affecting mark scheme calculations), and misstates population projections reaching 73 million in 2050 rather than the early 2030s.

mark_affecting.quote: projected to grow from roughly 68 million today to hit a staggering 73 million by 2050
consumes about 500 cubic meters of water and generates 4 to 5 tons of CO2 every single year
pushed EVs to over 30% of new sales

flagged.title: UK Settlement, Population & Economic Challenge
flagged.reason: The video presents 685,000 as the record UK net migration figure when the revised peak record was 944,000 in the year to March 2023.

mark_affecting.quote: In 2023, the record net migration figure... was roughly 685,000.
